Paragraphe · I recently tried Nowadays and it was a d
settings.text: I recently tried Nowadays and it was a delightful surprise. I immediately ordered it as a gift for my friends and family who I knew would love it just as much. The taste is light and refreshing, making it a perfect alternative to alcohol in various settings. Whether you're at a social event or having a quiet evening on the couch, Nowadays adds a unique touch to the experience.

settings.text: I love Nowadays because you can customize it to suit your tolerance - I love adding one serving to sparkling water, whereas my boyfriend (a more frequent plant magic user) can add more to get an extra buzz!

settings.text: Nowadays has become my drink of choice! It tastes so refreshing and does NOT make me feel gross after drinking it. My plant magic friends + new plant magic users LOVE it!! 10/10 would recommend
